evidence_boundary.corpus: Public professional materials, selected official sources, public repository metadata, and user-provided attachments.
evidence_boundary.identity: Research-programme evidence twin; not a personality clone and not authorized to impersonate Yucong Duan.
evidence_boundary.high_impact_actions: Human signature and purpose authorization required.
evidence_boundary.metric_interpretation: Repository and platform metrics are time-sensitive evidence signals, not direct measures of scientific truth or human worth.

limitations: The seed corpus is a curated public snapshot rather than a complete automated harvest of all repositories, papers, patents, talks, and private research records.
GitHub and ResearchGate counters are time-sensitive and may change after the snapshot date; ResearchGate publication counts may include technical reports and uploaded work products.
Repository-health scores in the demonstration are explicit engineering priors, not an independent scientific assessment of a person.
The reference runtime does not access private data, hidden model activations, patent-office APIs, production identity credentials, or autonomous external tools.
Functional workspace, self-model, purpose continuity, and causal-intervention properties do not establish phenomenal consciousness.
DL3 status requires independent reproduction, a non-founder maintainer release, and at least one real incident or contradiction replayed through the evidence lineage.
